title: Miami submits paperwork for Cam Vaughn to enter transfer portal, WR drops claims against school

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Miami submits paperwork for Cam Vaughn to enter transfer portal, WR drops claims against school
sources.description: Miami has submitted a legislative relief waiver request for Cam Vaughn to enter the Transfer Portal, and Vaughn has dropped his claims against Miami, Vaughn’s agent, Will Turboff of A&P Sports, told On3’s Pete Nakos. Vaughn was dismissed from the Miami earlier this month after joining the program in January. This story will be updated.
